nodes.summary: For natural numbers $m$, $n$ and $q$, let $S(m, n, q)$ be the set of natural numbers $k$ with $2k \equiv n - q \pmod{m}$ and $2k < n$, and let $T(m, n, q)$ be the set of natural numbers $k$ with $k \equiv n - q \pmod{m}$ and $k < n$, where the difference $n - q$ is taken in the integers. Then for all natural numbers $m$, $n$ and $q$ the sets satisfy $S(2m, 2n, 2q) = T(m, n, q)$.
nodes.title: Doubling identity for the composition index sets

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $m$ and $q$, the index set $S(m, 0, q)$ is empty.
